question: In which year was the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports Patiala established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1961**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS) was established in **1961**.
 
• It is located in the city of Patiala, Punjab, India.
 
• The institute was named after the Indian freedom fighter **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose**.
 
• It is often referred to as the "Mecca" of Indian sports due to its importance in the development of sports in India.
 
• NSNIS Patiala is known for providing advanced training and facilities for various sports disciplines and has produced numerous prominent athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Facilities and Training**

 
 
• NSNIS offers state-of-the-art facilities for training in various sports such as athletics, boxing, hockey, and wrestling.
 
• The institute also provides specialized coaching courses and certifications.
 
 
 
• **Role in Indian Sports**
 
 
• NSNIS has played a crucial role in the development of sports in India, contributing to the training of many top athletes and coaches.
 
• It has been instrumental in enhancing the performance standards of Indian athletes in national and international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Collaborations and Partnerships**
 
 
• The institute collaborates with various national and international sports organizations to improve training methodologies and facilities.
 
• It also engages in research activities to advance sports science and sports medicine.
 
 
 
• **Notable Alumni**
 
 
• Many eminent sports personalities have trained at NSNIS, including athletes who have represented India at the Olympics and other international events.
 
• Prominent alumni include Milkha Singh, PT Usha, and many others.
